description: Convert US dollars between published BLS CPI-U months or annual averages since 1913. Reports equivalent value, cumulative inflation, average annual rate and yearly table. Omit both months for annual mode; unavailable periods are rejected. Arithmetic on CPI, not financial advice. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)
name: inflation_calculator

outputSchema.description: Equivalent USD rounded to cents, CPI values, cumulative and annual percentages, signed years and year-by-year purchasing power. Annual rate is null for the same period.

title: Inflation Calculator
